headline: Monsters Take Over the Top Spot as Chargers Tumble Out of the Top 10
lede: League sources tell me the Monsters have seized the No. 1 ranking, riding a 6-game winning streak and a 6-0 mark over the last three weeks. Boom. Tombstones dropped from first all the way to No. 5 despite a 6-0 run of their own, while Waves rocketed up 48 spots to No. 22.

rankings.blurb: Monsters are the new No. 1 after climbing two spots, going 6-0 over the last three weeks with a 6-game winning streak and 179.5 PPG over that span.
Barracudas hold steady at No. 2 with a 74.7% all-play rate and 179.6 PPG over the last three weeks, though a 4-2 mark shows they have room to tighten up.
Nemesis are rolling at No. 3 on a 7-game winning streak, going 6-0 over the last three weeks and averaging 176.0 PPG in that stretch.
Chickens are flying up to No. 4 with a 15-game winning streak, the longest active run in the league, and a 6-0 mark over the last three weeks.
Tombstones fell from No. 1 to No. 5 despite a 6-0 mark over the last three weeks, a sharp reminder that the top of this table can change fast.
Kraken climb one spot to No. 6 on a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks and 167.8 PPG in that span, even with a 67.1% all-play rate.
Hurricanes jump five spots to No. 7, going 5-1 over the last three weeks on a 4-game winning streak after a big climb from No. 12.
Jockeys are the biggest riser in the top eight, leaping six spots to No. 8 with a 4-game winning streak and a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks.
Demons slid five spots to No. 9 even though they averaged a solid 157.9 season PPG, and their 4-2 mark over the last three weeks has to improve.
Razerbacks inch up to No. 10 with a 71.2% all-play rate and a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks, quietly one of the steadier teams in the league.
Monkeys dipped one spot to No. 11 after a 2-game losing streak and a 3-3 mark over the last three weeks, so they need to stop the bleeding.
SaltyDogs rocketed up 18 spots to No. 12 on a 2-game winning streak and 163.5 PPG over the last three weeks, one of the biggest moves in the rankings.
Hoosiers hold at No. 13 with a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks and a 69.3% all-play rate that keeps them firmly in the mix.
Yetis climb three spots to No. 14 on a 2-game winning streak and a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks, with a 67.9% all-play rate backing it up.
BearCats are surging up four spots to No. 15, going 6-0 over the last three weeks on a 7-game winning streak with 165.2 PPG in that span.
Deadly move up two spots to No. 16 despite a 2-game losing streak, averaging 163.3 PPG over the last three weeks on a 4-2 mark.
Bombers slip one spot to No. 17 even though they are 6-0 over the last three weeks on a 6-game winning streak, so the rankings math is cutting close.
KitKats dropped three spots to No. 18 despite a 6-0 mark over the last three weeks and a 6-game winning streak that deserves more respect.
Fox climb three spots to No. 19 on a 3-game winning streak and 159.7 PPG over the last three weeks, even with a 3-3 mark in that stretch.
Goats rocket up nine spots to No. 20, going 5-1 over the last three weeks on a 3-game winning streak with 156.3 PPG in that span.
Outlaws climb three spots to No. 21 on a 4-game winning streak and a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks, with a 62.1% all-play rate to match.
Waves are the story of the week, leaping 48 spots to No. 22 on a 3-game winning streak and 157.9 PPG over the last three weeks.
Roos surge up 17 spots to No. 23, going 4-2 over the last three weeks and averaging 154.8 PPG in that stretch after a big climb from No. 40.
Cellmates dropped four spots to No. 24 despite a 67.2% all-play rate, as their 140.1 PPG over the last three weeks is the real concern.
Chargers have tumbled 16 spots to No. 25 after being No. 9 not long ago, even though they are 6-0 over the last three weeks on a 6-game winning streak.

statOfWeek.title: Stat of the Week
statOfWeek.blurb: Waves dropped 205.78 this week, the highest score in the league. Boom. That is a monster week.

benchBlunder.title: Bench Blunder of the Week
benchBlunder.blurb: Plague left 46.59 points on the bench, posting 145.26 when the optimal lineup was 191.85. League sources tell me that is a painful way to lose a week.

heaterOfWeek.title: Heater of the Week
heaterOfWeek.blurb: Chickens have won 15 straight, the longest active win streak in the league. Nobody is hotter right now.

coolerOfWeek.title: Cooler of the Week
coolerOfWeek.blurb: Chupacabras have dropped 14 in a row, the longest active losing streak in the league. That is a brutal skid.

matchupOfWeek.title: Matchup of the Week
matchupOfWeek.blurb: Week 10 features the highest-ranked clash on the slate: No. 3 Nemesis at No. 9 Demons. Money is nice, but this one is for bragging rights.
